name: Teclada

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Browser-based SSH / privileged-access software for your own hosts ('Desktop PCs, datacenters, AWS, GCP, Azure and beyond'); sells no machines. Pricing lives on the homepage (#pricing), /pricing is 404: Personal free (non-commercial), Starter $100/mo (10 users, 150 systems), Pro $500/mo (20 users, 500 systems), Enterprise quote. Out of scope for a compute-sandbox ranking.
Inventory exclusion: remote access, no hosted machine sale verified. Card contains no numeric compute modes and no selectable price plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages
